story.title: Should I eat it!! Or take It?
paragraphs_en: He then thought, should I eat it?
Or should I take it home?
The rat tied it with a rope and pulled. The chapati did not move.
The rat ate some and liked it.
Then the rat ate some more.
Little by little the rat ate so much that its stomach…
